program.name: Pancake & Straddle
program.subject: Flexibility
program.blurb: Wide-leg flexibility toward the pancake: straddles, frog, butterfly and wide folds.
program.about: Wide-leg flexibility toward the pancake, folding flat over a wide straddle. Sessions move through straddle side reaches, frog, butterfly and wide forward folds, with hamstring work on alternate days. Every session ends with a pancake held as deep as it stays easy. Levels II and III lengthen the holds. Patient work for inner thighs, hamstrings and hips.
